_readme: Photos, recent highlights and Instagram posts for /gallery/ and elsewhere. PHOTOS: drop an image into public/images/photos/ and add an entry with its filename, a caption and honest alt text. HIGHLIGHTS: the 'Recent highlights' strip on the events page and the 'A year in the Society' strip on the homepage both read 'highlights' below - newest first, and the first four appear on the homepage. INSTAGRAM: paste the post URL from the share button; posts render as official Instagram embeds (loaded lazily, only on this page). Order in each list is display order.

highlights.title: The Archbishop's Visit
highlights.blurb: Archbishop Christopher Prowse joined us on campus in Semester 2, celebrating Mass and staying on to talk with students.

highlights.alt: Fr Anthony Walsh OP speaking with students outside the chapel at dusk
highlights.title: Dominican Retreat
highlights.blurb: Our Semester 2 retreat with the Dominicans - prayer, talks and quiet, in the tradition the Society grew out of.

highlights.alt: A large group of students gathered after a formation evening
highlights.title: MGL Faith Formation
highlights.blurb: A faith formation series run with the Missionaries of God's Love, working through the basics of the faith with plenty of room for questions.

highlights.alt: The chapel roofline and cross at dusk with Telstra Tower behind
highlights.title: Jesus Youth Adoration Night
highlights.blurb: An evening of Eucharistic adoration with Jesus Youth, the inter-university Catholic youth movement - music, silence and confession available throughout.

highlights.alt: Audience at the Jurisprudence and Theology lecture
highlights.title: Jurisprudence & Theology
highlights.blurb: The Hon Justice Steward AC of the High Court addressed ~200 people with the ANU Law School, May 2026.

highlights.title: The Apostolic Nuncio
highlights.blurb: Archbishop Charles Balvo celebrated Mass on campus and joined us for an evening of conversation, October 2025.
